input_usuario: Km total rodado pela frota em 2025.
query_referencia: SELECT SUM(CAST(num_marc_final AS INTEGER) - CAST(num_marc_inicial AS INTEGER)) AS km_total FROM frota_gastoFrota WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND num_marc_final > num_marc_inicial;
query_gerada: SELECT SUM(CAST(num_marc_final AS DECIMAL) - CAST(num_marc_inicial AS DECIMAL)) AS km_total_rodado FROM frota_gastoFrota g JOIN frota_frota f ON g.seq_veiculo = f.seq_veiculo WHERE g.ano_referencia = 2025 AND COALESCE(f.dsc_marca, '') NOT ILIKE '%DIVERSOS%' AND COALESCE(f.dsc_num_placa, '') NOT IN ('-1', 'NÃO INFORMADO');
